data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to convert HEIC/HEIF image files to PNG or JPEG format on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Converts HEIC and HEIF image files to PNG or JPEG formats on both Android and iOS devices. It allows specifying an explicit output path or automatically generating one in the system temporary directory based on the requested format.
use_when: You need to convert HEIC/HEIF photos taken on iOS devices to standard PNG or JPEG formats.
You need to process HEIF images on Android and iOS within a Flutter app.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose image cropping, caching, or UI rendering library.
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Simple API with a single core method for conversion.
Supports Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods for iOS.
weaknesses: Limited to only Android and iOS platforms.
Only converts HEIC/HEIF to PNG or JPEG formats.
